CustomField.description: Optional datetime that closes an availability window. The formTemplate runtime blocks rendering and shows the Offline Message once now is past this value; leave blank for no end gate. Pair with Start Date for seasonal or application-window forms.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: After this date and time the form stops accepting new submissions and shows your Offline Message instead. Leave it blank to keep the form open indefinitely; it pairs with Start Date to define an availability window.
CustomField.label: Close Date
